units.source_text: 夕雾左大臣家的宰相中将于大飨宴次日傍晚来玉鬘夫人邸内拜访。

en.t: The Counselor Middle Captain from Minister of the Left Yugiri's household came to visit Lady Tamakazura's residence on the evening after the grand banquet.

units.source_text: 他知道大女公子归宁在家，恋慕之心更切，对夫人说道：

en.t: Knowing that the eldest young lady had returned to her family home, his longing grew even stronger, and he said to the lady:

units.source_text: “猥蒙朝廷不弃，宠赐官爵，我心全无欣幸之感。

en.t: Though the court has graciously not cast me aside and has favored me with rank and office, I feel no happiness at all.

units.source_text: 只是私愿未遂，心常悲痛，经年累月，耿耿于怀，竟无自慰之方也。”

en.t: It is only that my private wish remains unfulfilled; my heart is always in pain, and through the passing years it stays fixed in my mind, leaving me no way to comfort myself.
After saying this, he deliberately raised his hand and wiped away his tears.

units.source_text: 此人年约二十七八，正当壮盛之年，容姿英爽焕发。

en.t: He was about twenty-seven or twenty-eight, in the prime of his youth, with a handsome and spirited appearance that seemed to shine.

units.source_text: 玉鬘夫人听了他的话，独自叹道：

en.t: After hearing his words, Lady Tamakazura sighed to herself and said:
These young noblemen really are disgraceful!

units.source_text: 世事任所欲为，而对官位毫不介意，只管在恋情上消磨岁月。

en.t: They do as they please in worldly affairs, care nothing for rank and office, and spend all their years absorbed in love affairs.

units.source_text: 我家太政大臣如果在世，我的几个儿子恐怕也会醉心于此种荒淫之事吧。”

en.t: If the Grand Minister of our house were still alive, I fear my sons too might have become infatuated with such wanton pursuits.

units.source_text: 她的儿子左近中将已升任右兵卫督；右中弁已升任右大弁，但二人都未任宰相，为此她心中不乐。

en.t: Her son, the Middle Captain of the Left Palace Guards, had already been promoted to Captain of the Right Gate Guards; the Right Middle Controller had become Right Major Controller, but neither of them had been appointed counselor, and this left her displeased.

units.source_text: 称为藤侍从的第三子也已升任头中将。

en.t: Her third son, known as To no Jiju, had also already been promoted to Head Middle Captain.

units.source_text: 就年龄而论，升官并不算迟，但总不及他人早达。

en.t: Considering their ages, their promotions were not especially late, but they still could not match others who had risen early.
Lady Tamakazura grieved and sighed over this.

units.source_text: 宰相中将后来总是寻机向冷泉院皇妃倾诉恋情。

en.t: Afterward, the Counselor Middle Captain was always looking for chances to confess his love to the imperial consort of Reizei-in.
